framing: PayPal averages 600 transactions every second, with spikes as high as 12,000–13,000 during peak periods.
In our 20+ year history, we use the data captured in every transaction to protect merchants and consumers alike.
To be a great payments company, we think of ourselves as a security company first.
Roughly 30% of our people work on risk and fraud.
We leverage up to 150 data points per transaction. This story shows about 6 of them.

streetView.note: Shinjuku hotel district — reveals IP maps to a hotel property

steps.title: A PayPal transaction begins

panel.text: PayPal transaction initiated
User: Jason T., based in Singapore

steps.narration: Our story begins with a user based here in Singapore.

steps.title: A red flag appears

panel.text: New unrecognized IP address on user's account
3am Japan Standard Time
Cross-border — inherently higher risk

steps.narration: The red line going to the other side of the globe indicates that we're detecting some suspect activity against Jason's account — at 3 o'clock in the morning Japan Standard Time, from an unrecognized IP address. At least, so far as Jason's concerned.

steps.title: A second red flag

panel.text: Delivery location is not where the user's account is based
Two red flags now identified
Most traditional risk models would decline on two red flags alone — the safe call, but the wrong one here
This purchase is legitimate; PayPal looks past the flags to the fuller story instead

steps.narration: Add to that the fact that the delivery location is not where Jason's account is based, and we've already identified two huge red flags that, for most traditional risk models, would lead to a decline of this transaction.

steps.title: Risk & Fraud steps in

panel.text: Traditional risk modeling would decline this transaction outright
Costs PayPal's merchant partners over $5 billion a year in valid transactions
PayPal approves and guarantees the transaction instead

steps.narration: For just the merchant partners that we at PayPal work with, we see losses of over 5 billion dollars a year in what are actually valid transactions. But PayPal can approve and guarantee this transaction, as we begin directly addressing the potential risk and red flags from the very second Jason presses that 'Pay with PayPal' button.

steps.title: The IP is a hotel

panel.text: Unrecognized IP addresses are cleared like a name check
IP confirmed as a valid hotel property
Raises the possibility that Jason has traveled

steps.narration: Unrecognized IP addresses are cleared just as simply as asking you your first and last name. We know here that this IP is assigned to a valid hotel property, which now raises for us the possibility of travel for our user.

steps.title: Evidence of travel

panel.text: PayPal takes a story-based approach to risk
Jason received a P2P payment 18 hours before the attempted purchase in Tokyo
Consistent with him having traveled across the globe

steps.narration: We take a story-based approach to risk, and the story here begins with a P2P payment Jason received 18 hours prior to the attempted purchase in Tokyo — which leads us to believe he has indeed traveled across the globe.

steps.title: Who is the recipient?

panel.text: Recipient in Texas identified via transaction history
Appears to be Jason's father

steps.narration: And the unrecognized recipient in Texas, based on Jason's transaction history, appears to be his father.

steps.title: 202 markets, one story

panel.text: PayPal operates in over 200 markets worldwide
Secondary data points — like local holidays and customs — are highly valuable in evaluating risk

steps.narration: Being in over 200 markets around the world, secondary data points like holidays and customs can be incredibly valuable in evaluating risk.

steps.title: A valid transaction

panel.text: Jason is jet-lagged in Tokyo
He received a Venmo payment from his brother
Together, they're buying their father a gift
Purchase valid and complete

steps.narration: Our story-based approach now concludes that Jason is jet-lagged in Tokyo, received a Venmo payment from his brother, and together they're buying their father a gift. Purchase valid and complete.

steps.title: Powered from Singapore

panel.text: Over 50 petabytes of core transactional data
Combined with PayPal's proprietary data science practices
Uniquely positioned to protect every user from risk

steps.narration: With over 50 petabytes of core transactional data, combined with our proprietary data science practices, PayPal is uniquely positioned to protect our users from any potential risk they might ever be exposed to.
